reference_findings.diagnosis: Potentially significant left-main disease; exact severity and revascularization strategy require careful expert assessment. Risk tier is not a formal score.
reference_findings.risk_assessment: High risk / potentially unstable anatomy; qualitative simulation label only, not a validated score.

investigation_reports.ecg: Sinus rhythm with nonspecific ST-T changes; no diagnostic ST elevation.
investigation_reports.laboratory_panel: Serial hs-cTn below fictional threshold with no significant delta; CBC, renal function and electrolytes included in pre-procedure panel and require review.
investigation_reports.echocardiography: LVEF 52%; no definite resting regional wall-motion abnormality.
investigation_reports.coronary_or_other_imaging: Reference angiography: visually estimated 60–70% distal left-main narrowing extending toward bifurcation; LAD and LCx ostia involved to a lesser degree; RCA 40% disease; TIMI 3 flow. Image interpretation is synthetic and intentionally leaves uncertainty requiring specialist review/intravascular assessment where appropriate.
investigation_reports.initial_vitals: HR 76 bpm; BP 130/76 mmHg; RR 16/min; SpO2 98%; stable in the snapshot.
investigation_reports.not_supplied: Any test not explicitly listed is not ordered/not available; it must not be interpreted as normal.

history.chief_complaint: Exertional chest pressure with a recent increase in frequency and reduced exercise tolerance.
history.history_of_present_illness: No pain at the moment of the initial assessment; recent symptoms are more frequent than baseline.
medication_reconciliation: Fictional statin and antihypertensive listed; verify exact agents and adherence
allergy_history: Prior rash to an unspecified antibiotic; not a contrast allergy; details require verification

pathway_review.reason: Left-main location and bifurcation involvement carry important prognostic implications.

pathway_review.label: Treat based only on a single visual percentage without anatomical/clinical review

pathway_review.reason: Negative biomarkers do not exclude high-risk chronic coronary anatomy.

reference_findings.safety_review: Review renal function, contrast reaction history, bleeding risk, consent, medication list and urgency; avoid using the scenario to prescribe a specific revascularization choice without complete Heart Team context.
reference_findings.simulated_clinical_course: Reference branch: lesion is escalated for expert anatomy review and Heart Team discussion; no one-click treatment answer is revealed as universally correct.
learning_objectives: Separate ACS biomarker status from anatomic risk.
Discuss uncertainty and Heart Team decision-making.
reference_findings.review_note: Synthetic scenario. Clinical values and pathway labels require qualified interventional cardiology review before deployment. Educational use only; not real-patient guidance.
